translation.name: Biblica® Wonhia ɛho kwamma nhoma Akuapem Twi Nkwa Asɛm

content.text: Asase nyinaa momfa ahosɛpɛw nteɛ mu mma Onyankopɔn!
Monto ne din anuonyamhyɛ ho dwom;
momma nʼayeyi nyɛ anuonyamhyɛ!
Munse Onyankopɔn sɛ, “Wo nneyɛe yɛ nwonwa dodo!
Wo tumi so mmoroso
a wʼatamfo nyinaa de osuro kotow wʼanim.
Asase nyinaa kotow wo;
wɔto ayeyi dwom ma wo,
wɔto dwom kamfo wo din.”
Mommra mmɛhwɛ nea Onyankopɔn ayɛ;
anwonwade a wayɛ wɔ nnipa mu.
Ɔmaa po yɛɛ asase kesee;
wɔnantew twaa nsu no
mommra mma yenni ahurusi wɔ no mu.
Ɔde ne tumi di hene daa daa,
na ɔde nʼani nso hwɛ aman so.
Mma atuatewfo nsɔre ntia no.
Aman nyinaa, munhyira yɛn Nyankopɔn,
momma wɔnte mo nkamfo no nnyigyei;
wahwɛ yɛn nkwa so
na wamma yɛn anan anwatiri.
Na wo, Onyankopɔn, wosɔɔ yɛn hwɛe;
na wonan yɛn sɛ dwetɛ.
Wode yɛn koguu afiase
na wode nneɛma a ɛyɛ duru too yɛn akyi.
Womaa yɛn atamfo twiw faa yɛn so;
yɛfaa ogya ne nsu mu,
nanso wode yɛn baa faako a nnepa abu so.
Mede ɔhyew afɔre bɛba wʼasɔredan mu
na madi bɔ a mahyɛ wo no so,
bɔ a mʼanofafa hyɛe, na mʼano kaa
bere a na mewɔ ɔhaw mu no.
Mede mmoa a wɔadɔ srade bɛbɔ afɔre ama wo;
adwennini ayɛyɛde;
mede anantwinini ne mpapo bɛbɔ afɔre.
Mommra mmetie, mo a musuro Onyankopɔn nyinaa;
momma menka nea wayɛ ama me nkyerɛ mo.
Mede mʼano su frɛɛ no;
na me tɛkrɛma yii no ayɛ.
Sɛ mede bɔne hyɛɛ me koma mu a,
anka Awurade antie me.
Nanso nokware, Onyankopɔn atie me,
wate me mpaebɔ.
Nhyira nka Onyankopɔn,
a wampo me mpaebɔ
na wanyi nʼadɔe amfi me so.
Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo. Wɔde sanku na ɛto.
